Version
Owner
People Team Effective date
January 1, 2026 Applies to All employees Next review January 1, 2027

1. Purpose This policy explains paid time off (PTO), holidays, sick leave, parental leave and other leave types available to Helix employees. Requests are submitted and tracked in the BambooHR portal.
2. Annual PTO Entitlement Full-time employees accrue PTO based on years of service. Part-time employees receive a pro-rated amount.
Years of Service Annual PTO Days 0 to less than 3 years 20 days
3 to less than 6 years 25 days
6 or more years 30 days

PTO accrues monthly and may be used as it accrues. A maximum of 5 unused days may be carried over to the next calendar year. Carried-over days expire on March 31. Requests for more than 3 consecutive days should be submitted at least 2 weeks in advance. Managers must approve or decline within 3 business days. In the United States, unused accrued PTO is paid out on termination where required by state law.

3. Company Holidays Helix observes 10 company holidays per year, plus 2 floating holidays that employees may use for cultural or personal observances. The holiday calendar for each country is published in BambooHR each December. Helix is closed between December 25 and January 1 in the US and UK offices; these days are covered by company holidays and are not deducted from PTO. Helix Cloud Technologies Internal - Confidential HR-002 | Leave and Time Off Policy | v3.1
4. Sick Leave

Employees receive 10 paid sick days per calendar year. Sick days do not carry over. Notify your manager as early as possible on the first day of absence. A doctor's note is required after 3 or more consecutive sick days. Sick leave may be used to care for an ill immediate family member.
5. Parental and Family Leave Leave Type
Duration
Pay
Primary caregiver parental leave 16 weeks
100% of base salary Secondary caregiver parental leave 8 weeks
100% of base salary Adoption or foster placement Same as parental leave 100% of base salary Bereavement - immediate family 5 days
Paid
Bereavement - extended family 3 days
Paid
Jury duty / civic obligation As required

Paid, up to 10 days Parental leave may be taken in one block or split into two blocks within the first 12 months after birth or placement. Notify the People Team at least 60 days before the expected leave start date where possible.
6. Other Leave

Unpaid leave: up to 12 weeks with People Team and VP approval. Sabbatical: employees with 5 or more years of service may take a 4-week paid sabbatical once every 5 years, subject to manager approval and business needs. Medical leave: handled per applicable law (for example FMLA in the United States); contact the People Team for guidance. End of document. Printed or downloaded copies are uncontrolled; the version in the internal policy portal is authoritative.
